title: Ashbury Rewards Guidance on Promotion Bonuses and Co-Brand Card Points
content:
Two kinds of Ashbury Rewards points reach an account from outside guest services: promotion bonuses and co-brand card points.

## The rule

Promotion bonuses are posted by Ashbury Rewards to members who registered for the promotion before the qualifying stay, carrying the promotion code. Co-brand card points are posted by the card issuer with each statement as co-brand card spend points, and count as qualifying activity when the tier's setting counts co-brand card points as activity. Guest services posts neither: a member who reports a missing promotion bonus or missing card points is outside the rules guest services can apply, because neither the promotion registrations nor the card statements are held in the member's records. A bonus row carries the promotion code it was earned under, and a promotion bonus is posted at most once per promotion code and stay.

## Who posts what

| Points | Posted by | Recorded with |
|---|---|---|
| Promotion bonus | Ashbury Rewards | The promotion code and the stay |
| Co-brand card points | The card issuer, with each statement | No stay; source co-brand card spend |

## Basis Q&A

**A member says a promotion bonus is missing from a stay. Can guest services post it?** No. Guest services posts no promotion bonus; the registrations are not held in the member's records, so the report is outside the rules guest services can apply.

**A member says the points from last month's card statement never arrived. Can guest services post them?** No, for the same reason: the card statements are not held in the member's records.

**Can one stay carry the same promotion bonus twice?** No. A promotion bonus is posted at most once per promotion code and stay; two different promotion codes on one stay are two different bonuses.
